bounty.title: Publish Sourcey docs for a maintained OSS library

producer.affiliation: Independent third-party reference; not affiliated with, endorsed by or published by the upstream maintainers.

summary: A Sourcey-generated documentation reference for the maintained third-party open-source library https://github.com/stretchr/testify, pinned to commit 87a7b9d57689f6579db2da795ab8deeab29cb724 (MIT). The pages were generated by Sourcey v3.8.3 with the godoc adapter over the committed godoc.json snapshot of the pinned tree and published at https://testify.anonymux.org/api. The governed run that backs this delivery was executed with the runx CLI (runx-cli 0.10.2) and is sealed in a signed receipt (sha256:f4d4d3855ab8d91db29cc1220e2a359e9f722dcdc583a7b661149839402a7b32) whose bytes are published next to these artifacts, so a reviewer can re-verify it. The publication is claimant-authored: https://github.com/stretchr/testify/pull/1996.
